props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initial layout keyed by panel id (percent 0-100) for uncontrolled usage.
Panels without an entry share the remaining space.

props.name: keyboardDelta
props.description: Keyboard resize step in percent of the group.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the full layout record for the current panel ids on every
layout change.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description:
Called once per completed interaction with the final layout record:
at drag end (only when the layout changed), on each keyboard step that
changed the layout, on collapse toggles, and on each
`Resizable.usePanel()` collapse/expand/resize call.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout axis used by the component Recipe.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled layout keyed by panel id (percent 0-100).
When provided the component is fully controlled.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: collapsedSize
props.description: Size in percent applied when the panel is collapsed.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Whether the panel can collapse to `collapsedSize`.

props.name: id
props.description:
Panel id. Used as the key in layout records and as the DOM id.
Generated when omitted.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum size as a percentage of the group (0-100).

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum size as a percentage of the group (0-100).

props.name: onCollapse
props.description: Called when the panel transitions to collapsed.

props.name: onExpand
props.description: Called when the panel transitions out of collapsed.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Whether the panel can be resized by handle interactions.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: children
props.description:
Handle content. `false` hides the decorative grip; a function receives
{@link HandleRenderProps} and mounts as a component.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: intersection
props.description:
Extends the hit target to the crossing handles of nested resizable
groups so the junction drags on both axes at once.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.
